title: MMXM v5 A_overnight_5mFVG_ce_c12_none, US100 + US500 CFD, frozen forward-only test
registered_at: 2026-10-04 (SAST); this file's git commit on main is the registration timestamp, not any script-written field
rule_object_root: /workspace/mmxm (not a git repo; files pinned by sha256)
selection: single frozen variant A_overnight_5mFVG_ce_c12_none; no sibling variant may be swapped in; no HTF bias
symbols: US100 and US500, each reported separately as primary; pooled numbers secondary

forward_feed.note: Forward feed is TradingView CAPITALCOM, NOT Dukascopy. Historical series is Dukascopy BID (mislabelled 'mid' in mmxm docs).

counting_rules.first_eligible_session: first NY session that starts after BOTH this file and the MMXM forward-harness sha256 (harness_sha256 below) are committed on main; earliest possible 2026-10-05
counting_rules.burned_windows: nothing before first_eligible_session counts; 2026-05-25..2026-09-25 is burned for MMXM (DATA fix 4)
counting_rules.raw_bars_required: every session (live or backfill) must persist the raw 1m bars it consumed (overnight 18:00 prior day -> 11:00 NY plus 1H context history) to raw/forward/<inst>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv with sha256 in the log row; a row without raw bars does not count
counting_rules.backfill: sessions after first_eligible_session may be backfilled only if raw bars are saved; backfilled rows carry note=BACKFILLED and are reported both with and without them
counting_rules.holiday_filter: exclude NYSE full closures and early-close days (see holidays below); historical re-report excludes 2025-11-27, 2025-12-24, 2026-07-03
counting_rules.min_bar_filter: session counts per symbol only if >= 86 of 90 1m bars in 09:30-10:59 NY and >= 791 of 930 1m bars in the 18:00->09:30 overnight range on the forward feed
counting_rules.timezone: all rule times America/New_York wall clock

holidays_excluded.maintenance: ORION-compiled from NYSE rules; DATA to verify against the published NYSE calendar and extend for each new year before that year's first session

binding_kill: cumulative pooled R <= -5R at any point from the first counted trade -> FAILS, stop
binding_pass_at_N_180: one-sided 95% lower bound > 0 (percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261004)
random-entry foil (same day/side/stop/R-targets, market entry at a random 1m bar 09:30-10:58, mmxm/baseline.py method) >= 95th percentile
total R positive on BOTH US100 and US500 separately
pooled total R with top 3 trades dropped > 0
binding_fail: kill line above at any time, or failing any pass criterion at N=180 = FAILS
non_binding_orion_gates: mean > 0 at 2x costs and under DATA measured-cost model (US100 1.617 / US500 1.01 RT)
max DD (R) <= bootstrap p95 at realized N (100: 6.5R, 180: 7.4R) and longest losing streak <= p99 (100: 8, 180: 8)
per-symbol kill: either symbol with N_sym >= 80 and 95% CI upper bound < 0 -> recommend FAILS
Holm alpha split across H013+H014 (one-sided 0.025, N 230) reported alongside
required_co_reports: US100 and US500 separately in every headline; pooled secondary
stream label FWD-TV-CAPITALCOM-US100 / FWD-TV-CAPITALCOM-US500 on forward results; DUKASCOPY-CFD-BID1M on historical citations
DATA measured-cost and fill-realism proxy (spread + 1 tick trade-through, stop slip 1 spread) alongside frozen-cost results
CAPITALCOM measured spread and price side (bid vs mid) before any forward R is read
random-entry baseline on the same days

harness_sha256.status: REGISTERED when this file lands on origin/main (the harness checks origin/main at run time and records the landing commit time); before that, rows are logged but never counted
harness_sha256.replaces: PENDING - an MMXM forward harness (CAPITALCOM only, raw-bar persistence, holiday + min-bar filters, frozen hashes above) does not exist yet; it must be built, hashed and committed here before first_eligible_session

changes_after_registration: any change to a pinned hash, feed, window, cost, exit or filter voids counting from that point and requires a new ID (H014b)
